title: slipstream.agent.connection.v1
$comment: Whether the agent chat bound to this capture can take questions. setup_pending: the chat was bound at attach but no setup check has completed. connected: the bound chat received a one-time setup check through its tool-use callback and returned it through its answer tool, proving delivery and answer return at this event's time. It does not prove the chat is still open later; a capture that is no longer live has no agent connection, which /v1/sessions reports. Self-contained; unknown fields permitted for forward compatibility.
